build_treeprocessors: build the default treeprocessors registry with inline, prettify, and unescape processors for a Markdown instance
run_inline_processor: run the InlineProcessor on an ElementTree to apply inline patterns and replace text with placeholders
run_prettify_treeprocessor: run the PrettifyTreeprocessor to add line breaks to block-level elements and clean up code blocks
run_unescape_treeprocessor: run the UnescapeTreeprocessor to restore escaped characters in element text, tail, and attribute values
create_custom_treeprocessor: create a custom Treeprocessor subclass that implements a run method to modify an ElementTree before serialization
